== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Universal Manufacturing, also referred to as U.M., is a major corporate entity and a significant competitor of the [[Vallenar Corporation]]. While the two organizations frequently engage in conflict, they also collaborate on various occasions. The company is primarily recognized for producing a wide variety of goods, specifically components utilized in starship navigational computers and replicators. Universal Manufacturing maintains a massive presence in the galaxy, managing a large portion of interstellar shipping operations and utilizing secure cargo transport vessels equipped with AI-monitored security systems. The organization is led by a skeletal President and employs specialized personnel, including enchanters and Archmages specializing in transmutation, to assist with their production processes. The company is headquartered on the planet [[Zykaros]], a location generally avoided by inhabitants due to the corporation's reputation for being unpleasant.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Universal Manufacturing is a company that seeks to expand its influence across the [[Galactic Union]]. Led by a skeletal President, the organization utilizes transmutation specialists within its operations. Additionally, the company maintains ownership of a secure cargo transport ship.}}
